lines.x: If you've got something to say, spit it out. I ain't got all day, you know?
Eep! You idiot, touch my tail again and I'll smack ya into next week! And you best forget whatever sound you just heard, or I'll make ya forget, the hard way.
This ol' door I have here? Can't you tell? I made it myself, it's multifunctional. Hands off if you know what's good for ya, or you might get yourself killed.

Gotta say, scabbin' a lift on this big ol' ship gets me to places faster than my own two legs. Besides, you lot are headin' all over the shop anyway. Mm, yeah, I guess I've changed my view towards you guys a little.
Don't lump me in with Magallan. I ain't no pro explorer, just someone trampin' it around the lands chasin' thrills. Trailblazin' for the benefit of others? Ha, do I look that noble?
What am I doin' this for? The danger and the thrill, mate. What's life without a little craziness, eh?
Magallan? I met her at the Black Flow. That tiny, overzealous videographer girl made that adventure the noisiest one yet. But I gotta admit, the li'l ripper's got some real chops.

Friend? Pfft, who needs that? I'd much rather be a complete jerk and keep things simple: you don't like me, and I don't like you. On second thought, I could use a drinking mate tonight... Oi, you in or what?

My Oripathy? Yeah yeah, I know it's bad, but as long as I ain't bothering no one, how I deal with it is my business. To me, it's real simple: dying on a journey seems like an alright way to go. You can try to save me, if you think you're all that. Do your worst, Doctor. Bet you couldn't if you tried.
Sleeping, huh? Good time to make some noise. Ahaha!

Alright, so here's the deal. I'll be out exploring for most of the year, but you still need to pay me full wage, and keep a dorm room for me. Think you can accept—Wait, you agree? Ha! You must be off your rocker.
Whatever. Guess I learned some self-defense.
Me? 'Honorary Captain of the Rhodes Island Expedition Team?' The hell?
I can't promise I'll do any good for Rhodes Island, that's not my style. But I can promise you this: if there are any mysteries on this land you want uncovered, then I'm your gal.
Teamwork? Give me a break…
Ugh, Doctor, If you wanna make my life hard, just say it to my face.
If you can't keep up, just find something to keep yourself busy.
Ugh... What a pain in the proverbial.
Yeah, yeah.
Fine, fine.
Sure, sure.
Righto, mate.
Suck it, loser!
Here's a door for ya!
You're pathetic as hell!
Piss off already!
I've braved savage winds and waves. This is nothin' but smooth sailing.
This sucks. I was hopin' for an adventure.
Enough, mate. Let's call it a day.
Ugh... Am I supposed to say 'there there' now...?
Time to head back to the dorms for a kip.
Huh?!
Oh right, gotta take a trip to the Doctor's office first…
Arknights.

Ahh crap, I forgot it's New Year's. Shouldn't have come back. I hate huge crowds like this... Even those Archosauria we came across in Sargon weren't this rowdy… Huh? Wait, wait! What're you grabbing my hand for? Let go! I'm going back to my room!
Got nothin' better to do again, eh?
Fine, fine, whatever! Take this and get out of my face! What kind of person are you, asking people to give you a present? Gah… Alright, mate, you got your gift. Now shut up, and get out!

Damn. And I thought New Year's would be the only special holiday here. Didn't know you got another one. Guess I picked just the right bloody time to come back. Shh-sh-sh, hold it right there. You want to talk, fine, but we'll talk over drinks. Otherwise, keep your trap shut.
